page.metaTitle: Earnings Release Monitoring — Real-Time IR & 8-K Alerts | WebMonitor.fyi
page.metaDescription: Track earnings releases, 8-K filings, and IR page updates in real time. Alerts within minutes of publication for analysts, IR teams, and traders.
page.subtitle: Real-time alerts on IR-page earnings releases and 8-K filings for every ticker you track. Five-minute polling during earnings season, hourly otherwise.
page.intro: During earnings season, the gap between the release posting and the first analyst note can be 30 seconds. Equity research teams, IR teams (watching peers), and active traders need real-time signal on every earnings drop. WebMonitor.fyi monitors each company's IR press release page and SEC EDGAR 8-K page in parallel — whichever publishes first triggers the alert.

setup.title: List the tickers
setup.body: Most users track 15–40 tickers — a focus sector plus peers plus a few benchmarks.

setup.title: Add two monitors per ticker
setup.body: IR-page press releases (catches the actual earnings release first about 60% of the time) and EDGAR 8-K page (catches it first the other 40%). Cross-coverage means no misses.

setup.title: Bump frequency during earnings windows
setup.body: Hourly for most of the year. Five-minute checks during earnings windows. The dashboard lets you batch-edit frequency.

setup.title: Webhook into Slack or Bloomberg-style chat
setup.body: The release lands in the chat with a link. The team sees it before competitors finish refreshing.

examples: Equity research analysts covering a sector of 25–40 names
IR teams monitoring peer earnings releases for competitive context
Hedge fund operators with concentrated positions tracking quarterly results
Portfolio managers running event-driven strategies around earnings
Journalists covering specific sectors on a tight publishing window
page.limits: IR-page monitoring catches whatever the IR team publishes publicly. Pre-market and after-hours-only releases sometimes go to wire services (PR Newswire, Business Wire) before the IR page; monitoring the wire-service company-page can supplement.

faq.q: How fast is the alert from publication?
faq.a: On a five-minute interval, the alert arrives within five minutes of the release posting. For sub-five-minute latency, the company's wire-service page often publishes first.

faq.q: Can I track guidance updates outside earnings season?
faq.a: Yes. Off-cycle 8-Ks frequently contain guidance revisions and material disclosures. The same monitors catch them year-round.

faq.q: Does this work for international companies?
faq.a: For ADRs filing with the SEC, yes. For purely foreign-listed companies, monitor their IR page directly — works the same way.
